chars.ZAYD: ZAYD: a fit 29-year-old Moroccan man with short black hair and a trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and black joggers, white sneakers
chars.YOUSRA: YOUSRA: a pretty Moroccan woman in her late 20s with long wavy dark-brown hair, wearing a burgundy blazer over a cream top and gold hoop earrings
chars.FATHER: FATHER: a stern Moroccan man in his 60s with grey moustache and glasses, wearing a white djellaba and a red tarboush
chars.MOTHER: MOTHER: a Moroccan woman in her 50s wearing a lavender caftan and a beige headscarf

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan family salon in Kenitra with traditional sedari sofas, the FATHER stands with arms crossed refusing coldly while ZAYD faces him, frustrated and hurt, hands open asking why. Tense confrontation, both faces clearly visible in the centre.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: The FATHER and MOTHER whisper secretly together in a Moroccan kitchen, smiling slyly while looking at a smartphone the mother holds, scheming expression.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: At the doorway of a Moroccan apartment, the MOTHER waves her hand dismissively saying no, while ZAYD stands outside holding a box of Moroccan pastries, disappointed.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: ZAYD sits on a sofa confused and thinking, while YOUSRA sits beside him looking away, avoiding his eyes, nervous and guilty.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: In a modern café in Casablanca, ZAYD suddenly takes YOUSRA's smartphone from the table, suspicious, while YOUSRA reaches out in panic to grab it back.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: In the café, YOUSRA forces a nervous smile and gestures, making up an excuse, while ZAYD stares at her with doubt, holding her phone.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: ZAYD quickly scrolls on the smartphone with determination, the screen glow on his face, while YOUSRA behind him freezes with her hand on her mouth.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close-up of ZAYD's face in shock, eyes wide and jaw dropped, lit by the phone screen he is reading, café blurred in the background.
